elements.body: EU's broad priorities are set by the European Council, which brings together national and EU-level leaders. Governments defend their own country's national interests in the Council of the European Union. Presidency shared on a rotating basis.
Directly elected MEPs represent European citizens in the European Parliament.
The interests of the EU as a whole are promoted by the European Commission, whose members are appointed by national governments.
